description: flakeyard action repositories: default rules, released files are fix

packageRules.description: What consumers run: the action and the tools of its flake, without the atoms, which are development tools (FY-0007, FY-0030, FY-0038)

Updates of the shared shell library are fix, so that they are released: the action runs it for its users; flakeyard/action-shell-lib stays until it is deleted, since its consumers move to lib-actions one by one; the rule follows the other commit types of the presets to win over them (FY-0035, FY-0040)
